title: Self-Accountability
coreMove: Move from what happened to what part you own while the moment is still changeable.
sourcePressure: The first strength interrupts autopilot by owning choice, error, contribution, and responsibility before blame or excuse can take over.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Making accountability moralistic or blame-heavy instead of operational for better judgment.

sourceAnchors.name: self-accountability interrupts autopilot
sourceAnchors.detail: Farnam Street podcast support gives this as the cleanest lawful mechanism for the chapter
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: Self-accountability interrupts autopilot by putting your contribution back inside reach.

counterintuition: most people think self-accountability is simple
